channel.title: Japan Small-Cap Filings in English
channel.description: English fact summaries of Japanese corporate filings from EDINET.

item.title: TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION: Toyota launches tender offer to buy up to 108,750,841 shares at 2,725 yen.
item.description: Tender offer price is 2,725 yen per share, a 10% discount to the 3,028 yen closing price on 2026-11-04 (the lower of that closing price and the one-month average of 3,030 yen). | Tender offer period runs from 2026-11-06 to 2026-12-07 (21 business days). | Planned purchase is 108,750,741 shares (0.92%); the maximum is 108,750,841 shares (0.92%). | The board on 2026-11-05 expanded the 2026-08-04 buyback cap from 500,000,000 shares to 610,000,000 shares and from 1 trillion yen to 1.3 trillion yen. | The tender offer is to be funded entirely from own funds, with 296,359 million yen needed for the purchase. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

Not investment advice.)

item.title: TOHO LAMAC CO., LTD.: TOHO LAMAC reports change of representative directors effective 2026-10-30.
